login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Sign in to {brand}
login.body: No password. We email you a link that signs you in.
login.devNote: In development the link is printed in the terminal running the dev server, not emailed.

errors.OAuthAccountNotLinked: That email is already signed up a different way. Use the method you used the first time.
errors.Verification: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.default: Something went wrong signing in. Try again.

login.passwordNote: We'll email you a link instead of asking for a password — there is no password to forget or to leak. The link is valid for 15 minutes.
login.devNoteBody: Google sign-in is hidden because AUTH_GOOGLE_ID is not set. In development the sign-in link is printed to the terminal running npm run dev — no email is sent.
login.panelAlt: Illustration of a young girl looking at a sprout through a magnifying glass, beside trays of microgreens

verify.title: Check your email
verify.heading: Check your email
verify.body: We've sent a sign-in link. It's valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once. You can close this tab.
verify.devNoteBody: no email is sent — the link is printed in the terminal running npm run dev.

forbidden.title: Not your area
forbidden.heading: Not your area
forbidden.signedIn: You're signed in as {who} with the "{role}" role, which doesn't have access to this page.
forbidden.anonymous: You don't have access to this page.
